title.narrative: Protection Enabling Environment and Resilience Services II (PEERS II)

description.narrative:
The proposed contract aims a strengthening the protection of vulnerable refugee, migrant and Libyan communities in Misrata : it builds directly onto phase 1 of the EUTF-funded project PEERS (T05-EUTF-NOA-LY-08 T05 1211), capitalising on lessons learned and best practices to offer a more refined action

The Impact (Overall Objective) of the action is to strengthen the protection environment and resilience of vulnerable populations. The Specific Objectives of the action are: i. persons in need[1] benefit from quality, lifesaving, multisectoral services and information, and ii. local stakeholders and communities enhance their performance in providing support to migrants. The action will directly benefit 12,165 individuals across all target groups, of whom 70% should report an improved feeling of safety and dignity. This will be achieved over 24 months by combining urban outreach and community centre-based programming that builds on Cesvi¿s established presence and experience in the area. Through three inter-related outputs the action will expand the identification of protection needs at communal level (Output 1), increase delivery of integrated assistance to achieve protection outcomes (Output 2) and enhance engagement with communities and local stakeholders to restore support networks (Output 3) for greater sustainability of the action.

[1] persons in need are defined as: migrants, refugees, displaced and non-displaced local communities
